ads_description: Hides advertising Pins in feeds and related recommendations.
backup_hint: Uninstalling the app or clearing its data resets Morphe settings. Export them first to restore them later.
board_download_description: Saves the pins already loaded: scroll the board to the end first.
board_download_skipped: Videos that need an external app (yt-dlp): %d.
board_no_pins: No pins loaded: scroll the board and try again
diagnostics_empty: No patch activity recorded yet. Open the Pinterest feed, then return here.
diagnostics_hint: Patch activity recorded in this session. Open the relevant screen to check a patch.
external_browser_description: Visit site opens the default browser. Pinterest pages stay in the app.
external_browser_title: Open links in the default browser
hide_ai_pins_description: Hides Pins that Pinterest marks as made or modified with AI.
hide_comment_button_description: Hides only the speech bubble, not the comments section.
hide_comments_description: Hides the comments section, preview and comment button.
hide_video_pins_description: Hides video Pins in feeds, including search. Video-only pages may be empty.
high_quality_description: Tries a verified original image, then falls back to the best available variant.
image_download_fallback: Original unavailable: downloading the best available variant
image_info_description: Dimensions, format and file size of the image selected for download.
info_replace_description: Shows dimensions and format in the action bar and hides both buttons.
info_replace_title: Image info instead of like and comment
keep_home_feed_description: Prevents automatic refresh when returning to Home. Pull down to refresh manually.
label: Set as wallpaper
long_press_download_description: Download an image from the long-press menu without opening the Pin.
menu_filter_description: Select the actions to hide. Clear their checkboxes to show them again.
navbar_note: Home and Profile cannot be hidden: Profile is the only way back here.
no_image: No image available for this pin
no_video: No video available for this pin
sanitize_links_description: Removes tracking parameters. Resolving a short pin.it link to a direct Pin link makes one network request.
screenshot_description: Also stops Pinterest from watching for screenshots, where possible.
search_history_description: Hides recent searches without deleting them from your Pinterest account.
search_modules_description: Sponsored carousel and featured boards. "Ideas for you" stays.
share_link_only_description: Shares the link without the promotional text Pinterest adds.
shopping_pins_description: Products and shopping suggestions in feeds.
startup_tab_description: Only when opening from the app icon. Hidden Search falls back to Home.
system_share_sheet_description: Uses the Android share menu for Pins. Boards, profiles and conversations keep the Pinterest menu.
toast_no_file_picker: No app on this phone can pick a file
verbose_description: Writes what each patch does: adb logcat -s Morphe:V
video_err_hls: Error: streaming format (HLS/DASH) is not directly supported
video_err_image_post: Error: this post is a static image
video_err_no_mp4: Error: failed to extract a downloadable link (MP4/HLS/DASH) from metadata
video_err_no_tracking: Error: no video tracking in memory
